name: BimClashIssueTracker
tagline: Turn clash reports into owned, dated, verified actions – by discipline, level and coordination round.
description: A complete design-coordination app for Power Apps and Power Pages: clash register by discipline pair, level and grid; assignment with due dates by priority; resolution, independent verification, accept-as-built tolerance rule and void; heat matrices, kanban board and a coordination-meeting agenda with recorded decisions. Drop it on a screen and it runs on demo data; point Items at your Clash Issues table to go live.
features: Due dates by priority (3/7/14/28 days, configurable)
Hard clashes beyond tolerance cannot be accepted
Bulk assign, status, priority and meeting notes with undo
CSV export of register and agenda
Phone layout with bottom view bar
